item.tib: kun bzang 'khor ba stong 'dren gyi me la las bcol sbyin sreg 'bul ba'i yan lag kun mkho 'jug bde snang srid dpal sbyin
item.coloph: zhes kun bzang 'khor ba stong 'dren gyi me la las bcol sbyin sreg 'bul ba'i yan lag kun mkho 'jug bde snang ba'i dpal sbyin 'di nyid rtsom pa po tshad ldan du gyur ba'i gang zag min na yang / snyigs dus kyi mi rnams rgyu tshogs la ltos pa'i don gshin sogs la bya sla don zab pa'i bon mchog 'di nyid phan 'dod kyi lhag bsam bzang po dang*/ snyan rgyud kyi bon kun bzang gi zhal lung byin rlabs can 'di la zhabs zhus te sems kyi gzhi bslang nas sngon gyi bka' rnying la rten nas bya 'phur gyi ming 'chang spa rus g.yung drung phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyi gnas chen shel 'od 'dzin pa'i ri sul rang dgon gsang chen smin grol bde chen gling gi bla brang bkra shis nor 'dzin nas rgyan skyong nyams len gyi thun gseng du bris pa'o//
